settings.cacheWarmingDescription: Shortly before the provider drops the prompt cache, Damocles re-sends the last request with a one-token output budget whenever the expected saving is worth the cost, which resets the cache clock so the next request is a cache read instead of a cache rebuild. Small contexts and cheap models often miss that bar, so no warm request goes out. A warm request is billed as a cache read of the full context plus one output token and never enters the conversation. Idle keeps warming for up to 30 minutes after the last request.

formula.cost: Sum of the recorded cost of every priced request, at API rates. A request with tokens and a recorded cost of zero is unpriced: its tokens are listed separately and never counted as $0.
formula.totalTokens: input + output + cache read + cache write
formula.cacheHitRate: cache read / (input + cache read + cache write)
formula.netCacheSavings: (cache read + cache write) × input rate − (cache read cost + cache write cost). The input rate is the request's own input cost / input tokens, or the model's list input rate when the request read no uncached input. Unpriced requests are excluded. Negative when cache writes cost more than the reads saved.
